_README: English -> Hindi for the /hi/ pages. aw/make-hindi-pages.js looks each visible string up here by its EXACT English text, so a wording change in a page makes its entry miss and the page drops below the coverage threshold rather than shipping half-translated. Run `node aw/make-hindi-pages.js --missing` to see what is outstanding. Category names match categories.name_hi in the database so the site and the apps say the same thing.
